tooltip.hemomancy.air_sigil.desc: ● Grants the speed of wind and the swiftness of a vortex
tooltip.hemomancy.magnetism_sigil.desc: ● Pulls all loose items toward you with invisible force (12-block range)
tooltip.hemomancy.resistance_sigil.desc: ● Envelops you in armor forged of condensed crimson blood
tooltip.hemomancy.movement_sigil.desc: ● Shifts even the heaviest elements with crimson force
tooltip.hemomancy.teleposition_sigil.des: ● Remembers a moment between instants. Reset memory [RMB + SHIFT]
tooltip.hemomancy.grow_sigil.desc: ● Bathes flora in fertilizer within a 5-block radius

research.hemomancy.hemomancy_origins.des: In ancient times, when the veil between worlds was thin, five crimson mages discovered the power hidden within the flow of life through blood.
This forbidden art - Hemomancy - allows one to command the essence of life itself, bending it to creation, destruction, and transcendence.
The book is your guide and vessel of knowledge, unlocked through rituals. Place it near the Mage Statue to receive visions of trials that raise your crimson level.
Begin your journey by crafting the book and seeking the guidance of the Statue. Only through sacrifice will you rise from mortal to archmage.
research.hemomancy.crimson_mage_path.des: The Mage Statue serves as conduit to the ancient council of crimson mages. It offers trials of blood and will, rewarding completion with increases to your mage level.
Each new level unveils deeper mysteries — from simple essence manipulation to summoning infernal entities.
Craft the statue from stone infused with your own essence. Place it in a sacred space to begin receiving quests.
Trials may demand the sacrifice of creatures or the gathering of arcane curiosities.
At the highest levels you approach transcendental power, where blood becomes the very fabric of reality.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.name: Life Essence
research.hemomancy.life_essence.title: Life Essence
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc1: Life Points are your currency, drawn from blood itself. The Sacrificial Dagger - or other crimson tools - extracts your own essence, converting vital force into pure power.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc2: Use it with care - excessive use invites corruption, a darkening of the soul that strengthens power yet threatens possession.
research.hemomancy.life_essence.desc3: Later you will harvest essence from creatures and rituals, but this path alone does not guarantee success.
research.hemomancy.blood_altar_foundatio: The Blood Altar is the forge where life essence is transmuted into items of power. Begin with the basic Tier 1 altar.
Infuse it with your blood to awaken it.
Place runes in specific structure positions to increase speed and capacity.
Incorporate resonant materials; corners now contribute to the structure.
Bind demonic glyphs for infernal enhancements.
Embed transcendental crystals; the altar now pulses with otherworldly energy.
Crown it with the highest infernal glyphs and chimeric runes - potential becomes limitless.
With a completed altar, craft blood orbs and runes to weave a network of souls.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.name: Vessels of the Soul
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.title: Blood Orbs
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc1: Blood Orbs store life essence within your soul network, required to power sigils and rituals.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc2: Each tier demands greater sacrifice and rarer materials, but the power is worth it.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc3: The Apprentice Orb expands capacity, enabling early sigils such as Air for flight.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc4: Magician and Master Orbs unlock advanced alchemy and demonic summoning.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc5: Archmage and Transcendental Orbs grant near-divine authority over reality through blood.
research.hemomancy.blood_orbs.desc6: The Infinite Orb defies all limits, yet invites eternal corruption.
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.name: Glyphs
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.title: Glyphs
Demonic Evolution
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.desc1: Glyphs are engraved symbols that channel life essence into powerful effects. Blank Glyphs are the foundation, infused at the altar.
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.desc2: Fortified and Crimson Glyphs enhance durability and potency for complex rituals.
research.hemomancy.glyphs_of_power.desc3: Filled, Demonic and Infernal Glyphs summon hellish forces - tread carefully to avoid soul corruption.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.name: Mastery of Crimson Alchemy
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.title: Foundations
Infusion
Alchemical Secrets
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc1: The Alchemy Table transmutes materials with life essence, birthing sigils and tools of power.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc2: It binds blood and matter - vital for advanced creations.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc3: Craft the table from resonant woods and crimson ornaments.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc4: Upgrade the Codex at the table to awaken foresight: view essence networks, altar structures and hidden rituals - your guide akin to ancient sigils of precognition.
research.hemomancy.alchemy_mastery.desc5: Mastery reveals transmutations that command the elements, from flowing waters to molten lava.
Runes enhance the altar: Speed accelerates crafting, Sacrifice amplifies yields from offerings.
Blank Runes are engraved with essence for customized effects.
Capacity and Resonant Capacity increase storage; Relations weave altars into unified networks.
Chimeric Runes fuse all effects into one, achieving ultimate efficiency.
Use Rune Stairs and Slabs to improve altar power without sacrificing aesthetic design.
research.hemomancy.sigils_of_command.des: Sigils are portable spells powered by life essence. Water and Lava summon fluids; Drainage expels them.
They bind to your orb, drawing from the soul network.
Air grants flight, Magnetism attracts items, Resistance bestows resilience.
Movement shifts blocks, Teleposition carries you afar, Growth rapidly nourishes flora.
research.hemomancy.crimson_artifacts.des: Crimson Steel Ingots are forged from iron tempered in blood - foundation for superior tools.
The steel enhances altars, strengthening their resonances.
Craft Crimson Steel for both beauty and enhanced functions of altar.
These crystals store pure essence, essential for exalted altars and orbs that distort reality.
research.hemomancy.desecrated_arsenal.de: Desecrated tools are weapons forged in blood: Pickaxe, Axe, Sword, Shovel - durable and imbued with essence.
They consume life points for superior mining, combat and digging.
Awaken them with infernal wills to gain intelligent traits such as self-repair or soul collection from the fallen.
